title: Kadosh Kadosh

hinglish.chorus:
Kadosh, Kadosh, Kadosh, Kadosh
Woh Khuda ka memna sinhasan par
Keval tu stuti ke yogya hai

hindi.chorus:
कदोश, कदोश, कदोश, कदोश
वो ख़ुदा का मेमना सिंहासन पर
केवल तू स्तुति के योग्य है

seo_description: Kadosh Kadosh lyrics in Hindi and Hinglish by ICM Church Worship Team — ICM Church 2025
